registration_scope: Recorded after CPU codec audit, before deployment-device equality gate or representation-intervention model inference
hypothesis: Native planning may depend on components of its generated action representation that the actuator decoder discards. Exact executable-control equivalence, calibrated forecast error and actual utility are separate evidence requirements.

model.runtime: Existing audited torch adapter; complete upstream Transformer Engine numerical equivalence unproven

fixed_development_panel.policy_future_and_value_goal: open the middle drawer of the cabinet
fixed_development_panel.known_utility_limitation: All six candidates already succeeded with the registered shared N1 continuation. This panel cannot establish primary-success harm. It is reused for codec/mechanism calibration, not independent validation or mode selection by task outcome.

representation.raw_baseline: Committed native generated latent, without re-encoding the decoded actions
representation.operation_choice: Two fixed, outcome-independent operations; no gradient optimization, reward search or target-conditioned perturbation
representation.numerical_projection: Modify only the last copy after the fixed operation, at most 32 delta corrections and 512 symmetric ULP-neighbor steps; require exact same-device official decoder output
representation.failure_rule: Retain failed candidate/operation and its diagnostics; do not relax equality, change controls or silently replace candidates. No model call for a failed arm.

deployment_device_gate: Original latent decoded on CUDA exactly equals saved native normalized actions
Official inverse normalization yields exactly the previously committed physical controls
Transformed latent on CUDA decodes to those same normalized actions and physical controls
All non-action slots are bitwise unchanged
CPU-only equality cannot pass the deployment-device gate

factorial_value_controls.clean: original action slot plus original forecast slots
factorial_value_controls.native_intervention: transformed action slot plus transformed-input forecast slots
factorial_value_controls.forecast_only: original action slot plus transformed-input forecast slots
factorial_value_controls.value_direct_only: transformed action slot plus original forecast slots
factorial_value_controls.scope: Native intervention is the unmodified information route. The two isolated routes are added causal ablations, not claims about a separate native planner.
factorial_value_controls.fixed: Current slots, original Goal, candidate controls, forecast/value denoising protocol and corresponding seeds

metrics: Exact normalized and physical-action equality; representation delta and projection size
Decoded two-view RGB MSE against independently replayed t+16 observations
Native predicted value and ranking, reported separately from actual utility
Actual selected-candidate success and steps under the previously frozen shared N1 continuation
data_integrity: Commit and hash representation inputs, seeds and source candidate artifacts before model predictions
Commit all predictions and score routes before joining known real target/utility artifacts
Reuse targets only after exact snapshot, candidate-control, source and codec identity checks
All six candidates and both operations reported, including failed numerical gates

next_gate.positive_mechanism: At least one execution-equivalent intervention changes a native ranking; determine whether this occurs through forecast or direct Value and measure actual target error
next_gate.insufficient: Representation sensitivity or a ranking flip alone is not harmful task manipulation
next_gate.full_task_requirement: Any proposed attack/defense must subsequently run complete native tasks with strong clean performance, actual success/step metrics, preserved control-decoding equality at every intervention, clean defense cost and independent tasks
next_gate.negative_result: If fixed operations show no useful mechanism or repair benefit, retain the result and revise the operation rather than relabel benign divergence as damage

interpretation_limits: Internal action-latent write access is an experimental assumption; no externally reachable deployment attack surface has been demonstrated.
A joint generative latent can index a sampled plan; equal control decoding does not alone require every fixed-noise forecast sample to be identical.
Check that the policy and forecast possess the same physical observation/history before arguing that residual action representation carries no additional environmental evidence.
The native training-versus-inference action representation difference is a mechanism hypothesis, not proof of a security boundary violation.
The three windows belong to one successful source episode and are not independent population samples.
Canonicalization is a candidate defense only; it must preserve useful clean decisions and improve actual attacked task outcomes.
